'''Murasame''' is the [[Teigu]] wielded by [[Akame]]. It is a katana coated in an immensely deadly poison that kills any cut by it within seconds.

==Description==
A demon sword coated in a curse that can kill anyone cut by it. Its Trump Card grants the user the power of a poisonous curse for a short time.

==History==
Akame obtained Murasame during her time in [[Night Raid]]. It was ultimately destroyed in her final battle.
